name: Hunting Horn Bow
text:
This +1 striking shortbow is made from an oryx horn hollowed out and reinforced with bone and leather. When turned around, the bow acts as a large hunting horn whose blast can be heard through even the densest forests, up to 5 miles away.

Activate—Rallying Call 2 (auditory)

Frequency once per day

---
Effect You signal your allies to close in on your prey. Choose one enemy within 60 feet. You and allies within 5 miles are Quickened until the end of your next turn and can use the extra action only to Step or Stride toward the chosen enemy.
